question: The list price of an article is ₹576. It is sold by allowing 20% discount on the list price. If its cost price is ₹480, then what will be the profit / loss percentage?
solution:
Given:

The list price of an article = ₹576. 

Discount = 20%

Cost price = ₹480.

Concept used:

Selling price = Marked Price - Marked Price × Discount%

Loss% = {(Cost Price - Selling Price) over Cost Price} × 100\%

Calculation:

Selling price = 576 - (576 × 20%)

⇒ 576 - 576 × 20/100

⇒ 576 - 115.20

⇒ ₹460.8

Now, loss% = [(480 - 460.8)/480] × 100

⇒ (19.2 × 100)/480

⇒ 1920/480 = 4

∴ The loss percentage is 4%.
